name: io.paretostudio/paretostudio-mcp
description: Read your ParetoStudio prompt, agent, and skill library from Claude Code, Cursor, and any MCP client. Install agents and skills as files into Claude Code.

environmentVariables.name: PARETOSTUDIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your ParetoStudio API key (starts with psk_). Create one at https://paretostudio.io/settings under Developer.

environmentVariables.name: PARETOSTUDIO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Only change this when pointing at a self-hosted or staging instance.
